notes.title: Early Access Update #5
notes.content:

[*] toggle V-SYNC

[*] toggle in-game cursor (software rendering for mouse cursor)
[/list]

[b][u]implemented audio settings menu[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] master volume slider
[*] music volume slider
[*] voice volume slider
[*] FX volume slider
[/list]

-performance improvements
-numerous bug fixes & map tweaks

notes.title: Early Access Update #4
notes.content:
Early Access Update #4 patchnotes: 

-Added better looking border to TV in tutorial
-Tutorial climbing video now no longer plays if not required, as was originally intended
-Checkpoint added to tutorial to remove need to retread steps if player dies during combat section, player will also respawn with a small advantage if they die during this section

notes.title: Early Access Update #3
notes.content:
Early Access Update #3 patchnotes:

-Reverted previous tutorial changes
-Video added to the tutorial explaining the climbing mechanic with on-screen button presses & an example. Video plays if player is unable to climb over initial obstacle within certain timeframe.

_____

General notes:

Please join the Discord (link in Main Menu) & let me know if you are having any issues with the game or can't figure something out. If you're having an issue then it is certain that others are too, please let me know so that I can improve the game.

All questions & feedback are welcome!

notes.title: Early Access Update #1
notes.content:
Early Access Update #1 patchnotes:

-Options menu button enabled in main menu & pause menu
-Added input settings menu (inputs can be set in game & from the menu. Configuration is saved on changing an input, loaded on game launch)

-Added video settings menu (incomplete, button disabled)
-Added audio settings menu (incomplete, button disabled)
